svt_mipi_dsi_host_sequencer Class Reference

List of all members.

Detailed Description

This class is UVM Sequencer that provides stimulus for the svt_mipi_driver class. The svt_mipi_dsi_host_agent class is responsible for connecting this sequencer to the driver if the agent is configured as UVM_ACTIVE.
